# paperclip_project (Resource)

Manages a Paperclip project, a body of work that groups tasks and links them to goals.

Workspaces, repositories and access members of a project are not managed by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "paperclip_project" "pre_production" {
  company_id    = paperclip_company.studio.id
  name          = "Pre-production"
  description   = "Script, storyboard and casting for the first short."
  status        = "in_progress"
  goal_ids      = [paperclip_goal.first_film.id]
  lead_agent_id = paperclip_agent.producer.id
  target_date   = "2027-03-31"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (String) Identifier of the company the project belongs to. Changing this replaces the project.
- `name` (String) Name of the project.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Colour of the project in the UI, as a hex code such as `#6366f1`. Chosen by Paperclip when omitted.
- `description` (String) What the project is about.
- `goal_ids` (Set of String) Identifiers of the goals the project contributes to.
- `lead_agent_id` (String) Identifier of the agent that leads the project.
- `status` (String) Status of the project: `backlog`, `planned`, `in_progress`, `completed` or `cancelled`. Defaults to `backlog`.
- `target_date` (String) Target completion date, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the project.
- `url_key` (String) URL-safe key of the project, derived from its name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Projects are imported by their identifier.
terraform import paperclip_project.pre_production 1d4e7a9c-3b5f-4a6d-8c2e-0f9b8a7c6d5e
```
